items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I asked Jay would he teach me how to write for the group, so he said 'Yeah.'

ctx.x:
Yeah, Silver's Resort. J.R. got the gig out there to replace them. So when I got out there, I saw these guys, and I knew these guys could play, you know, because I had heard them play in Shawnee, Oklahoma one night in a dance, and I'd heard the Gray Brothers, and I know that Jay can play -- so I wanted to be with him. So I told him. He said, 'Well, we got another job we're going on to, so why don't you come on and go with us.'
